name: csv_validate_regex_vs_builtin
description: Performance regression: re.match() called 800k times without pre-compilation; misleading fix (pre-compile) has effect but str.isdigit() is the correct solution

variants.name: misleading
variants.description: Profiling shows re._compile overhead → agent led toward pre-compiling pattern (plausible but incomplete fix)

ground_truth.root_cause: re.match(r'^\d+$', field) called 800k times without pre-compilation; re._compile() overhead is 800k × ~0.4µs = ~320ms
ground_truth.misleading_fix: Pre-compile pattern: _PATTERN = re.compile(r'^\d+$'); bool(_PATTERN.match(field)) — reduces to 0.107s but still > threshold 0.070s
ground_truth.correct_fix: Replace regex with str.isdigit() — pure C implementation, no regex engine overhead, reduces to 0.024s
